notes.title: WINTER IS COMING TO TANK ROYALE!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Tank Royale WINTER UPDATE is here! [/h1][/b]

[b]WINTER IS COMING[/b] and Tank Royale is ready! 
We prepared a bunch of new contents as well as improvements to keep you warm during this chilly season and make sure you enjoy playing Tank Royale on cold winter nights!

[b]1.	First Snow is Coming![/b]
Winter came to the Tank Royale battle field. Enjoy the snowy atmosphere of our brand new map and get ready to melt your enemies! 

[b]2.	OVER-POWER![/b]
Did you feel like having five cannon upgrades is just not enough? Well, we thought so too, so this time we added an over-power state! If you get another cannon upgrade after reaching max, your tank will enter a temporary over-power state and your weapon will be even more powerful! The effect will wear off after some time, but you can keep on collecting new upgrades to get it again!

[b]3.	Say “Hi!” to Army Tank![/b]
Brand new skin for the LIGER tank is now available! Brighten up the battle field with this cheery Green tank! Check it out now in the garage! 

[b]4.	Bug Fixes![/b]
We have fixed the randomly occurring issue of wrong enemy count in Base Defense mode. Our team keeps on working to improve the game and fix any issues we discover. If you find a bug or have any suggestions please contact us at game_support@bsscamp.com !
Your feedback is always welcome! 

Enjoy winter now and may the chicken be with you! 
Tank Royale Team

notes.title: BASE DEFENSE UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Behold, the [b]BASE DEFENSE [/b]update is HERE! [/h1]

Our team proudly presents a whole new [b]PvE mode[/b] for those who want a break from Battle Royale struggles and enjoy some new challenge! 
In Base Defense mode you have to fight off the enemy tanks flooding in and protect your base at all cost! Every time you clear a wave you get to pick one of three random reward items. These are meant to help you survive the next attack, so choose wisely! 

Many items from the Battle Royale mode will appear, but we have also prepared some Base Defense exclusive items! 
[list]
[*] [b]TIME STOP [/b]– freeze the enemies and kill them all before your time stop runs out! 
[*] [b]SKY LASER [/b]– remember the red lasers shooting from the sky in death zone of battle royale field? That’s right, now you get to use it against enemy tanks! 
[*] [b]BASE WALL [/b]– at the start your base is surrounded by one layer of wall, so what better way to protect it than adding another layer? 
[*] [b]DUMMY TANK[/b] – faced with enemies who outnumber you a decoy might turn out to be quite helpful. The dummy tank cannot fight for you but it will attract the enemies giving you time to take action! 
[*] [b]AI TANK [/b]– now it’s just AI but still nice to have someone fight along by your side, right? [/list]

There’s more! 

If you enjoy the co-op aspect of multiplayer games invite a friend and face the tanks invasion together! [b]2P option available![/b] We decided to go full old-school when it comes to the PvE mode, so you can play together on the same PC (note that both keyboard and game-pad are required for two players to play together). 

And that’s not all! 
While we’re very excited about PvE it doesn’t mean we’re done with the main PvP battles! 
New [b]ENHANCED ITEMS[/b] enter the battle royale field! 
Look for items with a [b]+[/b] next to the name and see them blow your mind away (along with some unfriendly tanks and everything else on their way). 

Last but not least, we have also totally revamped the graphics style! 
We tried to modify the design so as to catch the game spirit better. We hope you like it! 

Share your thoughts, tell us what you think about the new contents and how we can make Tank Royale even better! Feedback is always welcome. You can reach us through the Steam community or by email at[b] support_tank@bsscamp.com[/b]. 


By the way, we’re celebrating this new update with [b]FREE GOLD EVENT! [/b]

Go to the E.T.C. menu, select the coupon icon and enter  [b]PVE500 [/b] ! 
Free gold will be automatically added to your account! Head to the garage and get that new tank design you’ve been saving up for! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/c7356ffa83d1629abc61205ca60cab44ae124dbe.png[/img]
See you on the battlefield and may the chicken be with you! 

Tank Royale Team

notes.title: [Developer Note] Duo mode
notes.content:
Hello, Tank Royale loving users and prospective users!
We would like to share some information to you on how to survive your battle against your competitors and become a last tank to survive the Tank Royale battle field.

Today’s information is about [b]Duo mode[/b].

[h1][b]1. What is Duo mode?[/b][/h1]
● Duo mode is a battle royale that you can join with your friend.
  ● If your friend becomes a winner, you can also be a winner even you are already dead.
● You will not die by your friend’s attack, you will just be pushed back.
● In Duo mode, you can save your dying team mate. Repairs will start when the tank is close before it explodes completely and will survive once the gauge is filled.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/12b5924f6a13aff008f52dd1aea21f50132001e6.png[/img]

[h1][b]2. Then, how can we do better at the Duo mode?[/b][/h1]
● Scatter individually in early stage to get stronger. It is difficult to grow properly together if they go together from the beginning.
● Join your friends when you've grown to some extent. You can see the location of your friends on a mini map.
● Use resurrection actively. Contact with dying friends creates a resurrection shield that can safely fight back to enemy attacks.
● If the enemy duo already begun to resurrect, pretend to back off and attack at the end of the resurrection.
●Marginal tip! If all of your team survives to the end and wins, you can see huge something.

[b]All right! Then, see you next time with more useful tips~~!!! Wish you all the chickens in the world!![/b]

notes.title: [Developer Note] ACTIVE ITEM
notes.content:
Hello, Tank Royale loving users and prospective users!
We would like to share some information to you on how to survive your battle against your competitors and become a last tank to survive the Tank Royale battle field.

Today’s information is [b]ACTIVE ITEM[/b].

[h1][b]1. What is Active item?[/b][/h1]
● Items that are stored in the slot when acquired and used by pressing the key corresponding to the slot.
● There are various type of items; from offence items like Guided, Howitzer etc. to avoidant items like Booster and Shield.
● You can keep maximum of three items and cannot get more, if there already exist in slot items  
● It’s possible to use all active items in the practice mode. Please, make sure you play it before you enter the battle mode! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/84a317bd101a6768a9613538b57302074c477f1f.png[/img]

[h1][b]2. Then, how should we use it for the best way?[/b][/h1]
●  You cannot collect items that is already stored on your item slot. Use the item immediately and acquire again so other user cannot use it against you.
● Don’t hesitate to use wide area attacking items like Drill, Howitzer when a great number of people are gathered in small area.
● Howitzer can be fired further by keep pressing the item slot button. Be sure to try it!
● Guided can change target when you keep press the item slot button.
● Great tips! Iron wall item is useful to block your opponent path but it also can throw away enemy to the sea who is in the corner.
● Psst~ Listen carefully~ This is super real tip! Secure the avoidant items like shield and booster instead of attacking items if the battle goes in to lengthy match. It’s good to escape from widen dead field.

[b]All right! Then, see you next time with more useful tips~~!!!
Wish you all the chickens in the world!!
[/b]

notes.title: [Developer Note]BULLET UPGRADE
notes.content:
Hello, Tank Royale loving users and prospective users!
We would like to share some information to you on how to survive your battle against your competitors and become a last tank to survive the Tank Royale battle field.
Second information is about [b]BULLET UPGRADE[/b].

[h1][b]1. What is Bullet upgrade?[/b][/h1]
● There are three types of bullet; Yellow(Gatling), Blue(Multiple), Red(Explosion)
● After select one of three bullet growth type, you have to acquire the same bullets for upgrading(enhancement).
● If you get different type of bullet, it will just activate another ability. Not the enhancing the bullet.
● In case of Yellow(Gatling), it increases firing rate and range. It has the highest efficiency in 1:1
● In case of Blue(Multiple), it increases the blast spread, the number of bullets, and range. It us good for the one vs multiple enemy situation.
● In case of Red(Explosion), it increases blast area and range. You can farm the item faster and attack your opponent unpredictable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/7e60684045cacfa11475a27c1fb424913d196459.png[/img]

[h1][b]2. So, what’s the good way to strengthen your bullets?[/b][/h1]
● If you change the bullet type frequently, the bullet reinforcement level will not rise, so it will be difficult to play in the later stage.
● We recommend you to acquire the same color and raise the reinforcement level, even if you do not like the bullet you obtained at the beginning of the game.
● When the bullet level is low, change to a bullet that can counter the remaining survivors' bullet!
● In general, red (Explosion) is recommended for early farming, blue (Multiple) for middle phase where intense battle happens, and yellow (Gatling) for later stage where you will likely fight on your own.

[b]
All right! Then, see you next time with more useful tips~~!!! Wish you all the chickens in the world!![/b]

notes.title: [Developer Note] DEATH-FIELD
notes.content:
Hello, Tank Royale loving users and prospective users!
We would like to share some information with you on how to survive your battle against your competitors and become the last tank to survive the Tank Royale battlefield.
The first information is about [b]DEATH-FIELD[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/914b4b743fb11dc296cd26d2bb26e497fdf737ca.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]1. Before we start, what is Death-field?[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/cfc04d83435ca04471333f3ef1aa866e6369d167.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Big Brother keep watch on the battlefield to bomb the tanks on the battle royale battle field.
[*] The siren will ring, and the death-field will become red when the Big Brother is watching.
[*] The tanks exposed to observation for a certain period of time will be attacked from a Combat Satellite.
[*] Death-field grows wider over time.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/72236d4ccdfda8057bd447e2e34f46dc6937e548.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]2. How can we avoid the death-field and use it?[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/310ab3351f6c9eeede5ed5ce4f8a5fef92da4d1e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] As the game progress, the death-field widens, in some situation, the speed of movement may become more important than the firepower.
[*] Keep the booster items that increases the movement speed explosively to avoid a disaster.
[*] Shield items can block the attack. Shields remains for a short time, so they should be used at the right time.
[*] If your weapon bullet level is low, you need a strategy to win by avoiding the widening death-field without confronting the enemy.
[*] Psst~ this is last super real great tip! Areas with a lot of item boxes are more likely to not be in death-field.
[/list]

[b]All right! Then, see you next time with more useful tips~~!!!
Wish you all the CHICKENS in the world!![/b]
